theme: Independent offline reproduction, metadata counts and publication payload review of the museum and CISI 2 pilot packages
question: Do the two data-round packages reproduce their outputs, report correct coverage and agreement counts, and satisfy the source-handling rules before public commit?
outcome: Five museum commands and the CISI join and two scores reproduce all package outputs byte for byte. A guarded final-builder attempt reproduces its text/change outputs and stops at the explicitly prohibited parser dependency. Independent agreement and principal coverage totals pass. The excavation-area table needs 9 subarea additions and 3 dropped DK prefixes, and the holding-institution gain is 209. Combined museum-number coverage is 541 of 4695 families including bracketed readings, 518 under the whole-cell certainty rule, or 533 when any definite registration suffices. Nineteen findings comprise 9 publication blockers, 6 should-fix issues and 4 minor issues.
challenge: Restricted source values occur in examples and observed group endpoints; copied museum prose propagates through generated CSVs. Harvest flags differ from the report's classifications. The instructions require a builder that internally calls a prohibited parser, and another reviewer owns museum identity checking.
remedy: Preserved 75 starting files locally and verified matching before/after hashes. Reimplemented agreement, joining, usable coverage, source-set unions and excavation categories independently. Kept detailed source matches and membership rows local; proposed exact redactions and numerical/flag corrections without editing package or shared files. Stopped the parser dependency and reported its remaining scope explicitly.
retry_when: The coordinator authorizes the internal parser call, prepares redacted public counterparts and corrected harvest flags, or the separate join review changes accepted memberships. Preserve this endpoint and record any follow-up as a new verification output.
